paragraphs.text: Titania was the Maro-Sorcerer for the lush forest of Argoth , which was attacked by both sides for supplies at the end of the Brothers' War .

By some, she was considered to be a goddess . She was weakened due to the excessive plundering of the forests by the brother's armies. She tried to negotiate with both brothers, but they wouldn't leave. She then led the permanent offensive against both armies during the Battle at Argoth , becoming an avatar of Gaea and leading to the extinction of most of the lifeforms in Argoth. She eventually perished when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex , triggering the Sylex Blast during his final battle with Mishra .
Titania may be named after the fairy queen of the same name from Shakespeare 's A Midsummer Night's Dream .
